product_family: Devin – The AI Software Engineer. Multi-product suite including Devin Cloud (SaaS), Devin Desktop (IDE), Devin Enterprise (self-hosted VPC), Devin Review (code review), and CLI tools. Positioned for code migration, refactoring, and autonomous engineering tasks.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Cognition has been SOC 2 Type II certified since September 2024. Third-party evaluators assessed all security policies, procedures, internal and third-party controls related to data security, privacy, processing integrity, confidentiality and availability.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Trust Center lists compliance with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 as a standard framework for assessing the security program.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: DPA explicitly addresses GDPR requirements, stating commitment to compliance with 'the General Data Protection Regulation 2016/679' and use of Standard Contractual Clauses for international data transfers.

certifications.name: CCPA/CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: Trust Center lists CCPA compliance. Privacy policy states: 'When enabled, we will honor your opt-out preference and stop selling or sharing your personal information for targeted advertising purposes, as required by applicable law.'

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. DPA does not mention HIPAA and focuses on general data protection laws rather than healthcare-specific regulations.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in trust center, security docs, or DPA.

privacy.ai_training_note: Free/Pro tiers: Cognition states they 'may use User Content to train, fine tune and improve the models that power our Services' depending on applicable service terms. Enterprise tier: 'The organization does not train models on customer data or code by default.' This is a tier-dependent distinction that must be clearly understood at purchase.
privacy.data_region: Not guaranteed. Privacy policy states data may be transferred 'throughout the world, including the EU, UK and the US.' DPA allows transfers outside EEA using Standard Contractual Clauses but does not guarantee data residency in specific regions.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: All data transmission encrypted in transit

security.name: Session isolation
security.value: Devin operates in ephemeral VMs that are torn down after each session. Code is fetched from customer's git provider and changes pushed back.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Access to Cognition's AWS cloud environment granted on need-to-know basis, aligned with business roles. Limited employees/contractors have direct production access.

security.name: Multi-factor authentication
security.value: All employees required to use MFA with annual security training

security.name: Monitoring and logging
security.value: Production systems continuously monitored through logging, error handling, and real-time dashboards tracking live metrics

security.name: Data breach notification
security.value: Devin will inform customers without undue delay of any data breach involving customer personal data

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Vulnerability disclosure program allows security researchers to report issues to security@cognition.ai

security.name: Secrets management
security.value: Secrets Manager secures sensitive credentials separately from regular data flows

security.name: Annual third-party audits
security.value: Uses independent third-party auditors to assess security program at least annually against SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 frameworks

products.name: Devin Cloud
products.data_scope: Code and task context processed in Cognition-managed infrastructure. Free/Pro tiers may be used for model training. Enterprise tier data not used for training.
products.notes: Primary SaaS offering for autonomous code generation and task execution

products.name: Devin Desktop
products.data_scope: Code processed locally on developer machine
products.notes: IDE integration (formerly Windsurf). Data handling depends on connection to Cloud tier.

products.name: Devin Enterprise
products.data_scope: Data saved within customer-controlled VPC environment. Never used for training.
products.notes: Dedicated deployment within customer's Virtual Private Cloud. Highest data isolation.

products.name: Devin Review
products.data_scope: Code diffs and PR context for review automation
products.notes: Automated code review, visual QA, and bug identification

products.name: Devin CLI
products.data_scope: Task context and output processed through CLI
products.notes: Command-line interface for integrations and automation

products.name: Devin Windows VM
products.notes: Windows VM for visual QA and browser automation tasks

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based (Free/Pro/Teams/Enterprise). Free tier available. Enterprise requires custom pricing.
compare.data_residency: Not guaranteed in specific region. Standard offerings use AWS across EU/UK/US. Enterprise customers can negotiate VPC deployment.
compare.trains_on_data_note: Tier-dependent: Free/Pro may train on user content per service terms; Enterprise explicitly does not.

flags: AI training distinction critical: Free/Pro tiers explicitly allow use of 'User Content to train, fine tune and improve the models' (subject to service terms), while Enterprise tier excludes customer data from training. This is a major procurement differentiator and must be clearly communicated to buyers.

HIPAA NOT supported: Devin is not HIPAA-compliant and should not be used for regulated healthcare data without explicit vendor commitment. No references to HIPAA in DPA, privacy policy, or security documentation.
ISO 27001 certification date not publicly disclosed: Trust center lists ISO/IEC 27001:2022 as a framework, but no certification date is provided. Only SOC 2 Type II date (September 2024) is explicit.
Data residency not guaranteed: Customers requiring data to remain in specific regions (e.g., EU-only) cannot rely on standard Devin offerings without Enterprise/custom arrangement.
Outdated reference in DPA: DPA mentions 'SOC 2 Type I certification' but current certification is SOC 2 Type II as of Sept 2024. DPA may need updating.
Data training ambiguity in Free/Pro: 'User Content' definition and what 'applicable service terms' permit is not fully transparent without reading full service agreement.
